# travelens

> Travels Through A Lens — Chris Tham's travelogue documenting trips across many countries.

travelens is a static travel blog by Chris Tham (Sydney, Australia), recording personal travel
experiences with photography. Content is organised by trip, place/region, and tag.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://travelens.github.io/): Introduction, featured places, and about section
- [Trips](https://travelens.github.io/trips): Index of all trips in reverse chronological order
- [Tags](https://travelens.github.io/tags): Browse content by tag
- [RSS feed](https://travelens.github.io/rss.xml): Full RSS feed of all trips

## Feeds & structured data

- [RSS](https://travelens.github.io/rss.xml): RSS 2.0 feed
- [Sitemap](https://travelens.github.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages
- [Documents API](https://travelens.github.io/documents.json): JSON index of all trip documents

## Author
